strings.왠지 미뉴에트에게 와야 할 것 같은 기분이 들어서…. 그동안 별 일 없었: I somehow felt I should come see you, Minuet... Nothing's happened, has it? I mean, have you been well?
strings.(잘 있었냐는 말에 미뉴에트가 살짝 놀란 표정을 짓는다. 그러다 평소의: (Minuet looks slightly surprised at being asked whether she has been well, then returns to her usual expressionless face.)
strings.전과는 다른 느낌의 인사여서요. 잘 있었냐는 인사가 순간 너무 좋게 느껴: That greeting felt different from before. For a moment, being asked if I'd been well felt so wonderful...
strings.네, 저는 잘 있었어요. 아드리카도 평온하고요. 모두 모험가님 덕분이에요: Yes, I've been well. Adrica is peaceful too. It's all thanks to you.
strings.아드리카에서 라피어를 바라볼 수 있는 것은 정말 좋아요. %s 님도 잘: It's wonderful to be able to look at Laphia from Adrica. Have you been well too, %s?
I have. Oh, I visited a new region in the meantime.
Because of a witch, I imagine.
strings.오래 전부터 마계는 우리가 있는 세계를 계속해서 연결하려고 했죠. 이리스: The Demon Realm has been trying to connect to our world for a long time. Iris said she'd sensed such attempts recently...
Among them was a force trying to connect to the Demon Realm from this side...
strings.도움을 받아 정보를 모으고 있어요. 그래서 새로운 지역에서 새로운 마녀를: I'm gathering information with help from others. That's how I met a new witch in that new region.
Please tell me about your visit...
I may be able to help.
Oh, of course. It all started when...
strings.(미뉴에트에게 아이에 섬에 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (You tell Minuet what happened on Aie Island.)
I'm a little surprised to hear an incarnate god is there.
I'd like to meet him someday... Someone I didn't recognize, but who recognized me...
strings.그분의 주인이셨던 고대신은 과연 어떤 분이실지 궁금해요. 가이아 님께서: I wonder what the ancient god he served was like. Lady Gaia may know.
strings.마력으로 움직이는 게이트가 가득한 곳의 이름이 네레이스 관문이라고 하셨죠: You said the place full of gates powered by magic is called the Nereis Gateway?
strings.많은 사람들이 다녀가고 마력이 가득한 그곳이라면 어쩌면 모래시계에 대한: With so many people passing through and so much magic, there might be a clue about the hourglasses there.
strings.그러면 이야기가 나온 김에 바로 모래시계를 찾으러 가볼게요. 아직까지 큰: Then, now that we've mentioned it, I'll go look for the hourglasses right away. Nothing serious has happened yet, but it's better to check.
Take care... Thank you for telling me...
What does it feel like to be given the will to live...?
strings.%s 님, 어서 오세요. 안 그래도 에담 군과 %s 님 이야기를 하고 있: Welcome, %s. Edam and I were just talking about you, %s. And here you are!
strings.연희 님이 알려주신 엘리아스 식 표현대로 오셨군요. 호랑이도 죽으면 가죽: You've arrived just as the Elias saying Yeonhee taught me goes. A tiger leaves its skin when it dies...
strings.노토스 님, 다른 표현과 헷갈리셨나 봅니다. 까치가 울면 반가운 손님이: Notos, I believe you've mixed it up with another saying. It was, 'When a magpie calls, a welcome guest arrives'...
That's right. Yeonhee taught me so many that I must have confused them for a moment.
Anyway, I'm sorry I couldn't properly greet you then. It was my oversight.
strings.관문의 책임자로서 게이트를 제대로 확인 했어야 했는데, 이용객들을 위험에: As the gateway's supervisor, I should have checked the gate properly. I put its users in danger.
strings.폐하를 비롯해 많은 분께서 괜찮다고 하셨지만, 그래도 게이트에 지식이 가: His Majesty and many others have said it's all right, but I was arrogant to believe I knew everything about the gates.
I will have to study them more closely. Sigh...
You already do your part just by being here, Edam.
strings.아, 맞다. 연희 님이라면 프레이오스 서부로 가신 게 아니었어요?: Oh, right. Didn't Yeonhee leave for western Freios?
strings.무슨 일인지 가시는 길에 일행과 떨어져 길을 잃었다고 다시 관문으로 오셨: For some reason, she became separated from her companions on the way, got lost, and returned to the gateway.
strings.아무래도 연희 님과는 앞으로 관문에서 자주 뵐 수 있을 것 같은 기분이: I have a feeling we'll be seeing Yeonhee at the gateway quite often. Edam also handles assistance for lost visitors, so it should be fine.
When she left, she promised to pay close attention to her surroundings.
strings.아하하, 다른 별일은 없는 거죠?: Ahaha. Nothing else unusual has happened, then?
strings.…네, 지금 당장 큰일은 없는데, 혹시 도움이 필요한 일이 있으신 겁니까: ...No, nothing serious at the moment. But is there something you need help with? Just say the word, and I'll assist.
I just wanted to hear a few things.
strings.노토스 님, %s 님에게 그걸 말씀하시는 건 어떻습니까?: Notos, why not tell %s about that?
strings.…그럴까요, 에담 군? %s 님, 다름이 아니고…. 동생에게 전할 편지를: ...Shall I, Edam? %s, the thing is... I've lost some letters meant for my younger brother.
strings.저희 아버지께선 마음을 전할 때 늘 편지를 쓰셨습니다. 말로 하기 어렵다: Our father always wrote letters when he wanted to express his feelings. He said that if something was hard to say aloud, we should convey our sincere thoughts in a letter.
strings.…그래서 저는 동생과 다툼이 있으면 늘 편지를 보내 화해를 청했죠. 하지: ...So whenever my brother and I argued, I would send a letter asking to make peace. But after Zephyros and I took different paths, every letter came back... Haha...
strings.저희 집안 사람들의 마법으로만 볼 수 있는 각인이 새겨져 있는데, 아무래: They bear a mark visible only through our family's magic. Apparently, he dislikes that.
strings.그렇군요. 그런데 그 편지를 어디서 잃어버리셨어요?: I see. Where did you lose the letters?
strings.…부끄럽지만 제 방입니다. 제 실수지요. 이곳에서 불어오는 바람은 마력에: ...I'm embarrassed to say, in my room. It was my mistake. I forgot that the wind blowing through here is sensitive to magic...
strings.제가 창문을 연 채로 반송된 편지를 정리중이었는데, 그때 안으로 바람이: I was sorting the returned letters with the window open when a gust came in and blew them all outside.
strings.마력의 소용돌이로 들어갔다고 봐야 해서 찾을 길은 거의 없는 것 같습니다: They must have entered a vortex of magic, so there seems little chance of finding them.
...I hurried to track where the wind went... It was the island.
Aie Island... I'll go and look.
strings.다시 갈 일이 있어서 그러니까 미안해하지 않으셔도 돼요. 가는 김에 찾는: I have another reason to go back, so please don't feel bad. I'll look while I'm there, though you shouldn't get your hopes too high...
strings.그래도 감사합니다, %s 님. 아, 아이에 섬으로 가는 게이트를 그대로: Thank you anyway, %s. Oh, you can use the same gate to Aie Island.
strings.어, 아이에 섬으로 가는 게이트는 폐쇄된 거 아니었나요?: Huh? Wasn't the gate to Aie Island closed?
strings.%s 님을 비롯해서 몇 명만 쓰실 수 있도록 게이트의 운용 술식을 바꿨습: I changed the gate's operating spell so that only a few people, including you, %s, can use it.
Thank you. See you both later.
I hope you reach the island without any trouble.
strings.(헤이든이 환하게 웃으며 눈인사를 한다. 물론, 마리의 손 인사도 잊지: (Hayden greets you with a bright smile and a nod, remembering to wave Marie's hand as well.)
With that person... I mean, Circe gone, everything has returned to normal.
strings.스킬라 님도, 글라우코스 님도 충분히 쉬고 계셔서 괜찮은 것 같아요. 비: Scylla and Glaucos are both getting plenty of rest, so they seem all right. Although Circe's curse still hasn't been broken...
strings.현재 상태를 너무 부정적으로 보시진 않는 것 같아요. 빨리 방법을 찾아서: They don't seem overly unhappy with their current condition. Still, I hope we find a way to restore their original forms soon.
If I learn how, I'll tell you too.
strings.아이에 섬에 와주셔서 고마워요. 글라우코스 님을 비롯한 섬에 있는 모든: Thank you for coming to Aie Island. Glaucos and every other being on the island welcome you.
strings.(헤이든의 말과 함께 방금 전까지 보이지 않았던 인형들이 갑자기 뒤에서: (At Hayden's words, dolls that were nowhere to be seen suddenly appear behind him.)
strings.자, 환영의 박수!: Now, a welcoming round of applause!
strings.(인형들이 헤이든의 지시에 따라 모험가를 향해 박수를 친다. 그리고는 아: (Following Hayden's instructions, the dolls applaud the adventurer. Then they disappear somewhere as though nothing happened.)
What? What do you mean? Surely the dolls here were people under a curse...
strings.사람들이 저주에서 풀리면서 쓸만한 솜들이 여기저기 많이 떨어졌어요. 그래: When the people were freed from the curse, lots of usable stuffing fell all over the place. I collected it and made dolls.
strings.궁금해서 그런데, 인형을 무슨 일 때문에 만들었어요?: I'm curious. Why did you make them?
strings.키르케의 저주 때문에 많은 정령과 요정이 떠나거나 수명을 다했어요. 그나: Because of Circe's curse, many spirits and fairies left or reached the ends of their lives. I managed to revive a few... But they couldn't maintain their original forms...
strings.그래서 인형 안에 들어가도록 했어요. 글라우코스 님께서도 축복해주셔서 안: So I had them move into dolls. Glaucos blessed them too, allowing them to move stably.
strings.이리스 여신님께서도 지금은 아니지만, 나중에 원래의 모습으로 돌아갈 수: The goddess Iris also promised to help them return to their original forms someday, though she can't do it right now.
strings.찾으시는 물건이 있으시죠? 모래시계 아니면 또 뭐가 있는 거죠?: You're looking for something, aren't you? An hourglass, and what else?
So you know about the hourglasses too, Hayden.
strings.모험가님께서 프뉴마에서 떨어진 모래시계를 찾고 계시다고 다른 정령이 이야: Another spirit told me you're looking for the hourglasses that fell from Pneuma.
strings.그거 말고 찾고 계신 물건이 뭔지 말씀해주시겠어요?: Would you tell me what else you're looking for?
I'm looking for letters that were carried here by the wind.
strings.(헤이든이 뭔가 알았다는 표정을 짓자 품에 있던 인형 마리가 두 팔을 번: (As Hayden's face lights up in recognition, Marie raises both arms in his embrace and shows you something.)
This, right? There's magic left in it, so it seems important...
strings.(헤이든이 %s에게 노토스의 것으로 보이는 편지를 전달한다.): (Hayden hands %s a letter that appears to belong to Notos.)
strings.아, 맞는 것 같아요. 혹시 더 있나요?: Oh, yes, I think that's it. Are there any more?
strings.제가 가지고 있는 건 이거 하나지만, 바람에 실려온 편지가 전부 아이에: This is the only one I have, but it seems all the letters carried by the wind came to Aie Island. Oh, you'll need to hurry.
strings.미세하지만, 마력을 품고 있는 물건이라 인형과 악마들이 반응했을 수도 있: They contain a trace of magic, so the dolls and devils may have reacted to them. They might have torn them up or used them for something else.
Then I'd better find them quickly.
strings.편지를 찾아 주인에게 돌려주신 후에 머릿속에 떠오르는 장소로 가세요. 그: Once you've found the letters and returned them to their owner, go to the place that comes to mind. The hidden hourglass will awaken there.
When you find it, bring it to me. I'll send it back to Pneuma.
Thank you, Hayden. I'll start looking right away.
Yes, and... Oh, you've already gone.
strings.(헤이든이 모험가의 뒷모습을 보다가 마리의 팔을 들어 머리를 긁는 시늉을: (Watching the adventurer leave, Hayden raises Marie's arm and makes her scratch her head.)
strings.편지가 많아서 도와드리려고 했는데 괜찮으시겠지, 마리? 응? 모험가님은: There were so many letters that I wanted to help. Will it be all right, Marie? Hm? You think the adventurer will be fine?
strings.(노토스가 멀리서 오는 %s의 모습을 보고는 서둘러 달려온다.): (Notos spots %s approaching in the distance and hurries over.)
My goodness, I never thought you'd find them all.
strings.편지가 생각보다 많더군요. 50통이나 될 줄이야…. 제가 순식간에 우체부: There were more letters than I expected. Fifty of them... I felt like I'd suddenly become a postal worker.
strings.죄송해요, 제가 눈치없이 농담을 했어요. 나쁜 의도를 가지고 말씀드린 건: I'm sorry. That was a thoughtless joke. I didn't mean anything bad by it.
strings.하하, 아닙니다. 괜찮습니다. 동생과 제대로 이야기하지 못한 제 잘못입니: Haha, no. It's all right. It's my fault for failing to talk properly with my brother.
He dislikes me so much he won't even accept my letters.
You've gone to such trouble. How can I ever repay this kindness?
strings.(노토스가 %s에게서 잃어버린 편지를 받고 환하게 웃는다.): (Notos smiles brightly as he receives his lost letters from %s.)
It's all right. I didn't do it expecting anything in return.
strings.개인적인 일은 잘 끝내셨습니까?: Did you finish your own business?
Not yet. I thought there might be a clue if I went to the island...
strings.(분명 모래시계가 아이에 섬에 있었다면 헤이든이 이야기해줬을 텐데….): (If the hourglass had been on Aie Island, Hayden surely would have told me...)
strings.잠깐 괜찮으시면, 제 이야기를 들어주시겠습니까?: If you have a moment, would you listen to my story?
strings.제가 제피로스에게 편지를 계속해서 쓴 건 화해하고 싶어서였습니다. 추구하: I kept writing to Zephyros because I wanted to reconcile. Both over our different approaches to magic and as family...
strings.10년 전, 아버지가 사고로 돌아가셨습니다. 둘만 남게 됐을 때, 저희는: Ten years ago, our father died in an accident. When it was just the two of us, things were far from easy.
strings.흔한 영웅담의 주인공 소년처럼 금방 일어나 세계의 중심이 되는 그런 행운: I sometimes wished for the kind of luck a boy in a heroic tale has: to rise quickly and become the center of the world.
strings.신께서도 소년의 바람을 들으셨는지 많은 분들의 도움으로 저희는 다행이 수: Perhaps a god heard that boy's wish. With help from many people, we were fortunate enough to attend a small boarding school in the capital.
strings.동생이 인기가 많아서 소녀들과 염문이 있었죠. 어떤 소녀는 저에게 안경쓰: My brother was popular and had romantic entanglements with girls. I suddenly remember one girl telling me she'd break my glasses if I wore them. Her name was Chloris... Oh, she...
Ahaha... Zephyros and Chloris are both working at the academy now.
strings.그 이야기를 듣고 놀랐습니다. 하하하. 지금 두 사람 사이가 어떤지는 모: I was surprised to hear that. Hahaha. I don't know what their relationship is like now, but...
strings.저희는 졸업하면서 자연스레 마법청에 근무하게 됐습니다. 그리고 우연히 한: After graduating, we naturally came to work for the Magic Bureau. Then, by chance, we discovered something.
That the Magic Bureau had been involved in what happened ten years ago...
strings.아…. 저는 그 일에 대해 잘 아시는 줄 알았습니다. 폐하와 관련된 일을: Oh... I thought you knew about it. Since you work on matters connected to His Majesty...
I don't know the details... I just have the impression that something bad happened.
strings.그러시군요. 언젠가 때가 되면 아실지도 모르겠네요. 지금은 함구하겠습니다: I see. Perhaps you'll learn when the time comes. For now, I must remain silent. I'm sorry.
strings.하하, 그 일 빼고는 더 말씀드릴 수 있습니다. 그 때, 동생과 저는 저: Haha. Apart from that incident, I can tell you more. At the time, my brother and I disagreed and had a terrible argument...
I left the Magic Bureau and went to the Sage's Tower...
strings.언젠가 동생과 얼굴을 마주보며 제대로 이야기하고 싶습니다. 함부로 말하지: Someday, I want to face my brother and talk properly. I should not have spoken so carelessly...
You're a good older brother. I'm sure that day will come.
strings.고맙습니다, %s 님. 형제와 친구, 같은 영혼을 지닌 존재로서 조금 더: Thank you, %s. As brothers, friends, and beings who share the same soul, we should be a little more honest with each other.
strings.벌써 시간이 이렇게 됐군요. 저는 이제 돌아가 업무를 해야 하는데, %s: Is it that late already? I need to get back to work. What are your plans, %s?
strings.아, 저…. 갑자기 가볼 곳이 떠올랐어요!: Oh, I... I just thought of somewhere I need to go!
It's a secret. Ahaha, for a moment I sounded like someone else...
strings.그러시다면 배웅해드리겠습니다. 길드연합 쪽으로 가시는 거겠죠?: Then allow me to see you off. You're heading toward the Guild Union, aren't you?
Yes. Huh? Sigh... Yes, that's right. No hiding it now.
Haha. I hope your journey is uneventful. Until next time.
strings.(…동생을 위한 마음이 느껴지네. 생각나는 장소라면 마법학원인 것 같은데: (...I can feel his love for his brother. The place that comes to mind is the Magic Academy... Should I start by searching the training hall?)
strings.(마법학원 학생회의 협조를 받아 이곳저곳을 살피던 중, 한쪽에서 노란색으: (With the cooperation of the Magic Academy's student council, you search here and there and spot something glowing yellow to one side.)
...Here it is. I'm glad I found it sooner than expected.
strings.보기만 해도 행복해지는 기분이 들어…. 누군가 행복해지길 바라는 마음만으: Just looking at it makes me happy... Even simply wishing for someone else's happiness... Oh, right. The yellow hourglass must contain the emotion of happiness...
strings.아, 모래시계의 영향이라서 그런건가. 후우, 무슨 소리를 하고 있는 거야: Oh, is that the hourglass's influence? Phew, what am I saying? I'd better hurry back to Hayden.
strings.(이번에도 헤이든이 인형 마리의 손을 흔들며 맞이해주고 있다.): (Once again, Hayden welcomes you by waving the doll Marie's hand.)
I felt happiness approaching from the moment you stepped onto the island.
strings.많은 생명이 가진 감정의 일부가 담긴 이 모래시계가 이렇게 강한 힘일 줄: I never knew this hourglass, holding some of the emotions of so many living beings, would be so powerful. If even a spirit like me can feel it...
I found it quickly thanks to you, Hayden.
strings.오히려 제가 감사드려요. 정령은 생명을 위해 일하는 존재지만, 이런 감정: I'm the one who should thank you. Spirits work for living beings, but we don't easily experience emotions like these.
strings.제가 이 감정을 느낄 수 있는 건 정말 행운이에요. 모험가님을 만나서 다: I'm truly fortunate to feel this emotion. I'm glad I met you.
strings.마리, 너도 행운이지?: You're fortunate too, aren't you, Marie?
strings.(헤이든이 인형 마리도 그렇다고 말하는 것처럼 고개를 끄덕이는 제스쳐를: (Hayden makes the doll Marie nod, as though she agrees.)
strings.그러면 제게 모래시계를 주시겠어요?: Then would you give me the hourglass?
strings.여기요. 이 모래시계를 사라지게 하려면 정령의 힘이 필요하잖아요. 그러면: Here. It takes a spirit's power to make this hourglass disappear, right? Will you chant a special spell or perform some special action too?
strings.저는 따로 그런 건 준비하지 않아서…. 주문을 외우는 정령이 있다는 건: I haven't prepared anything like that... I've heard that some spirits chant spells. But I don't.
strings.(헤이든이 근처에 있던 바위 위에 인형 마리를 내려놓는다. 그러자 마리가: (Hayden sets Marie on a nearby rock. She nods as though she understands.)
strings.지금 마리가 움직인 거 봤죠? 제가 잘못 본 거 아니죠?: You saw Marie move just now, didn't you? I wasn't imagining it, right?
strings.(전혀 모르겠다는 표정과 웃음으로 상황을 무마하려고 하네…. 일단 지켜보: (He's trying to smooth it over with a smile and a look of complete innocence... Let's watch for now.)
strings.(마리가 헤이든에게서 노란색 모래시계를 받아 빙글빙글 돌기 시작한다. 잠: (Marie takes the yellow hourglass from Hayden and begins spinning. Soon, yellow light streams from the hourglass, scattering across the island.)
strings.(그렇게 한참을 돌던 마리가 어지러운지 그대로 주저앉는다.): (After spinning for a while, Marie sinks to the ground, apparently dizzy.)
Well done, Marie. Take a little rest.
The sand of emotion has returned where it belongs.
strings.아, 죄송해요. 모래를 담았던 통이 사라지지 않고 남아있네요. 어쩔 수: Oh, I'm sorry. The container that held the sand hasn't disappeared. It can't be helped.
strings.아무래도 이것도 있던 곳으로 돌려보내는 게 좋겠죠?: I suppose we should send this back where it came from too?
strings.(헤이든이 가볍게 웃으며 빈 모래시계를 하늘을 향해 던진다. 빈 모래시계: (With a small smile, Hayden tosses the empty hourglass skyward. It drifts into a vortex of magic and quickly vanishes.)
strings.(어디선가 뭔가에 맞아 고통스러워하는 부엉이 소리가 들려온다.): (Somewhere, an owl cries out in pain, as though something has struck it.)
Was that my imagination? I thought I heard an owl being hit by something...
The empty hourglass has gone to Pneuma, so don't worry too much.
strings.이제 남은 건 두개 맞나요? 열정과 사랑에 대한 감정, 희망과 평화를 바: There are two left now, correct? Emotions of passion and love, and the wish for hope and peace...
strings.모험가님이 나머지 두 개의 모래시계를 어디서 어떻게 만날지는 모르겠지만…: I don't know where or how you'll encounter the remaining two hourglasses...
strings.아직은 나타나지 않은 것 같아요. 어딘가에서 나타났다면 정령들은 느끼고: But they don't seem to have appeared yet. If they had appeared somewhere, the spirits would sense them.
strings.(헤이든이 쓰러진 마리를 다시 품으로 데려와 안는다.): (Hayden picks up the collapsed Marie and holds her again.)
Once again, thank you, Hayden. I'll see you later.
strings.아니에요, 모험가님. 앞으로도 도움이 필요하시면 말씀하세요. 정령은 생명: You're welcome, adventurer. If you need help again, please ask. Spirits exist to work for living beings.
strings.(헤이든이 쓰러진 마리를 다시 품으로 가져와 안는다. 방금 전까지 움직였: (Hayden gathers the collapsed Marie back into his arms. The doll who moved only moments ago lies as still as an ordinary doll.)
strings.…역시 세계는 내가 알 수 없는 것 투성이야. 저 인형도 그렇고…. 언젠: ...The world really is full of things I don't understand. That doll included... I suppose I'll find the other two hourglasses someday...
strings.(순간, 마리가 움찔하는 것이 모험가의 시야에 들어온다.): (For an instant, the adventurer catches Marie twitching.)
strings.(지금도 잠깐 움직인 것 같은데…. 그냥 모른 척 해주자.): (I think she moved again just now... Let's pretend I didn't see.)
